promise.t: You’ll know exactly what we found — and exactly what it costs — before we start.
promise.p: Open 7 days, Saturdays and Sundays included, {{site.hours}}.

trust2.p: The certification insurers and home inspectors ask about.
trust2.p-2: A real look at the chimney, no charge, no obligation.
trust2.p-3: You see what we see before any work.
trust2.p-4: Given at your home. Nothing starts without your OK.
trust2.p-6: Read what homeowners say about Northmark on our Google Business Profile.
trust2.p-7: The inspection is free and the price comes before the work — not after. Materials and labour are covered by a warranty on every job.

check.p: The same 19 points on every visit, in the same order, worked through by a WETT-certified technician — whether you booked a sweep or just want to know where you stand. You get the report and the photos, free.

prices.h2: What It Costs, In Plain Numbers
prices.p: Two prices we can publish, and one we can’t — because nobody can price a repair honestly without seeing the chimney first.
prices.p-8: Winter pricing for a standard chimney sweep, inspection included. Call and we will confirm it for your chimney before booking. Open 7 days, Saturdays and Sundays included, {{site.hours}}.

reviews.p: Reviews are one thing. Here is what you can verify for yourself, on sites we do not control.
reviews.p-2: Every review above is on Google, written by the homeowner, with their name on it. Whatever is there — good or bad — is what people wrote.
reviews.p-3: Wood Energy Technology Transfer is the Canadian standard for solid-fuel appliance work. Ask to see the card when the technician arrives — he carries it.
reviews.p-4: Every before-and-after on this site is a Northmark job. No stock photography, and no images bought from a library.
reviews.h3-4: The written report, before you pay
reviews.p-5: You get the 19-point report and the camera photos whether or not you book any work. The price comes with it, in writing, before anything starts.
reviews.p-6: Had work done by Northmark? Open our Google profile, tap “Write a review” and say what we did and where — it helps your neighbours choose.
